name: headline-prompt-v1-vs-v2
title: Prompt v1 vs v2 on Hermes with Claude Haiku 5.5: 10 held-out tasks x 10 trials
description: The real experiment of 5 Nov: one harness (Hermes Agent, pinned), one model (Claude Haiku 5.5), the same tools and settings; only the system prompt differs. v1 is the agent as it was; v2 adds the fixes found in v1's traces on the discovery tasks (every rupee figure exactly from a tool, clarify before assuming, explain figures plainly). 200 trials on the 10 held-out tasks, graded by deterministic checks. Result: v2 passes 73 of 100, v1 64 of 100, +9.0 points (95% interval +3 to +16), sign-flip p = 0.0625: no detectable difference under the rule set before the run, because only 5 tasks could differ. Its A/A calibration (v1 against itself) came out -4 points (-12 to +3). On 6 Nov (D83) its trials were regraded with the LLM judge, Gemini 3.8 Flash with rubric v4: the judge's verdicts are shown on every trial with how far to trust them, but they count in nothing (the judge failed the trust bar on the held-out labels). See docs/experiment.md and docs/judge-validation.md.
experiment_name: Headline: prompt v1 vs v2 on the 10 held-out tasks
